item.title: EplayerX 1.2.59
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改善部分网络环境下 TMDB 海报、横图和影片资料的加载，并优化首页图片清晰度和滚动时的加载表现。 - 播放器显示当前视频的下载速度，缓存播放时也能正确反映网络用量。 - 改善 SubHD 字幕下载，可复用已完成的微信验证，减少重复验证。 - 更新会员页面布局，让权益和购买选项更易浏览。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。
## What’s New
- Improved loading of TMDB posters, backdrops, and title details on some networks, and refined image quality and loading while scrolling Home. - The player shows the current video’s download speed and reflects network usage during cached playback. - Improved SubHD downloads by reusing completed WeChat verification where available. - Refreshed the membership page to make benefits and purchase options easier to browse.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later.
